Make our dent in the universe

We've always admired computing pioneers from the 60s, 70s, and 80s - the folks who dreamed big and built the foundations of the digital world. With LLMs and intelligent systems changing the game, we believe this is our moment. The most exciting time for tool building since Engelbart gave his demo in 1968. We are pinching ourselves that we get to work on this product, with this team, at this time. This is our shot.

We're humans, building for humans

Building a great product is rare. It takes a lot of care, love, and effort on the part of the people building it. We are a group of humans that have fun together, that care about each other, and that make each other better. We have all worked at companies that didn't feel human, so appreciate how special this opportunity is.

Designed in London, built for the world

We admire Silicon Valley, but we believe in London. Punching above its weight in design, talent, and taste. Granola is building a tool that not only makes you work better, but think better, and we can't wait to share some of the things we have in the works to bring new capabilities to people. We're on a journey to making Granola the place your team gets work done, with so much more to build. And we'd love your help.

Momentum

Now is a great time to be joining Granola. Here are a few things that have us excited.

InvestorsWe've raised a $125M Series C at a $1.5bn valuation, led by Index Ventures and Kleiner Perkins. Our investors include:

  • Top tier VC funds: Index Ventures, Kleiner Perkins, Lightspeed, Spark, NFDG
  • Angel investors: Mike Krieger (Instagram), David Lieb (YC Partner), Guillermo Rauch (Vercel), Amjad Masad (Replit), Tobi Lutke (Shopify), Karri Saarinen (Linear), Lenny Rachitsky (Lenny's Newsletter), Des Traynor (Intercom), Karim Atiyeh (Ramp), Zach Lloyd (Warp), Soleio, Charlie Songhurst, Noah Weiss, Romain Huet, Nilan Peiris and Laura Modiano.

Loved by teams at the world's most innovative companiesGranola is trusted by teams we admire — from companies like Vanta, Brex, and Intercom to fast-growing startups like Cursor, Linear, and Replit

We're growingEach day Granola transcribes millions of minutes of conversation. Teams that adopt it tend to stick around — and it spreads quickly from leaders to entire organizations

Still lots to figure outWe're scaling fast, but there's still so much to build. Plenty of space to make big moves with the product and have a huge impact on the trajectory of the company

The team

We're a friendly bunch

Benefits & Perks

Casa Granola and The Beach HouseTwo team getaway houses: one in sunny Majorca, one a stone's throw from London in Margate. Free for off-sites, deep work, or a relaxing break with friends and family.

Parental Leave20 weeks for primary caregivers, 12 weeks for secondary — fully paid.

Retirement SavingsUK: Modern, flexible pension via Penfold with up to 7% matching on full salary & salary sacrifice. US: 401(k) with 100% match on your first 3% of salary.

Health InsuranceUK: Bupa cover for you and your family. US: Medical, dental and vision through Aetna/Kaiser.

Commuter BenefitsUK: Get a new bike tax-free through our Green Commute Initiative scheme, or access subsidised bike share through CycleSaver. US: Pre-tax dollars for transit and parking.

Gym BoostA monthly contribution toward your gym membership.

L&D BudgetAn annual budget for courses, books, conferences — whatever helps you grow.

Life InsuranceUK: 4× your annual salary for your dependants. US: 2× up to $750k — just in case.

Income ProtectionUK: 75% of your salary if you're out of action long-term. US: 60% up to $12k/month.

Time OffUK: 25 days plus bank holidays. US: Unlimited PTO.

Daily LunchFresh lunch delivered to the office every weekday, on us.

Flex PerksWork late? Dinner's on us. Remote up to four weeks a year. Office-first, with flexibility built in.
